page: Microsoft Azure DC96ads_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture using AMD processors and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 96 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type includes 3686 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable execution times for demanding workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the DC96ads_v6 offers a balanced ratio of compute to memory alongside a substantial local SSD allocation, reducing the need for external storage attachments for data-intensive tasks. This hardware profile is structured for workloads such as relational databases, enterprise applications, data processing pipelines, and general-purpose server deployments requiring high core counts and local storage capacity.
